title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Financial Hardship Program
content:
**Program rule.** Financial hardship on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility accounts is decided individually, never routinely: a patient applies through a hardship application request and supplies household income documentation. The hardship tier is the first row of the hardship ladder whose income ceiling, as a percentage of the federal poverty level, is at or above the documented household income; income above the last row earns no tier.

## Documentation window (time gate)

The hardship approval is recorded no later than the class's documentation period after the hardship application is submitted, counting calendar days from the day after the submitted date with the boundary day included; an application whose documentation is not complete by then is denied.

- Clock starts: the submitted date of the hardship application request on record.
- Counting: calendar days, day 1 being the day after the submitted date.
- Comparison: the approval date must be no later than the last day of the period; the last day itself qualifies.

Boundary cases (abstract, period of N calendar days): an approval recorded on day N after the submitted date is within the window; an approval recorded on day N plus one falls outside the window, and an application whose documentation is not complete by the end of day N is denied. With the 30-day period in every payer class, an application submitted on 1 June can be approved through 1 July inclusive.

## Approval term

An approved tier stays in force for the class's approval term, in calendar months, from the hardship approval date.

## Effect on charges

While the approval is in force, each charge of the deductible, coinsurance, copay or repair-patient-share type receives an adjustment with the reason "hardship discount". *Retired clause, no longer in force:* the clause fixing that adjustment as "equal to the tier's discount percentage of the charge's open amount, rounded to the cent half up" has been superseded by the current basis. Charges already open on the approval date receive the discount only if posted within the class's lookback period before the approval date. Self-pay, upgrade-difference, non-covered-with-notice and unreturned-equipment charges never receive a hardship discount.

## Points of judgement

| Fact on record | Consequence |
|---|---|
| Documented income at 260 percent of the poverty level | first row at or above 260 is the 300 row: partial-50 tier |
| Income above the last row | no tier |
| A repair-patient-share charge posted while the approval is in force | receives a hardship-discount adjustment |
| A self-pay charge | never receives a hardship discount |
| A charge open on the approval date, posted outside the lookback period | does not receive the discount |

superseded_clauses: equal to the tier's discount_pct of the charge's open amount, rounded to the cent half up
